no-reader:long-sub.title: Nobody reads notifications
no-reader:long-sub.message: Customer Communication Preferences Synchronisation Service publishes to notifications, but nothing consumes it: it keeps every message, unread.
no-reader:long-sub.rationale: A topic keeps what's published until its retention ends, whether anything reads it or not. With no consumer group, nothing acts on its messages, and more partitions don't change that.

fix.label: Add a consumer…
fix.choice: Pick what reads notifications, then add it and connect long-sub to it.
